english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the termination or conclusion of an event, process, or relationship.
Use this when completion means the ending or conclusion of an event, period, or process.
This is the all-purpose noun for an ending or conclusion, especially when something marks that an episode is over.
Use 結束 for the cessation of an activity, effort, state, or motion.

examples.english: The ending of this relationship is finally here.
